items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: "Is Taylor there?" -- that's the White man.

ctx.x: Yeah. Right here in West Dallas. So I happened to be sitting there by the phone at the front door, the next day about 3 o'clock. And one of them sheriffs called down there from the County Jail, and says, "Is Taylor there?" -- that's the White man. I said "No." I answered the phone. I said, "No." There was a boy in there cleaning-up, sweeping going on back there. So I said, "No." He said, "Well, who are you?" I said, "Well, I'm one of the bandleaders. I'm Buster Smith."
